definitions.explanation: The first frost that appears in autumn or early winter, marking the transition to cold weather. An important seasonal marker in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧{初霜|はつしも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|お}りた→降りる：00568_oriru⟧。
examples.english: The first frost fell this morning.

examples.japanese: {初霜|はつしも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れ→訪れ：14267_otozure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When news of the first frost arrives, you can feel winter approaching.

examples.japanese: {初霜|はつしも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I need to bring the garden plants indoors before the first frost.

notes:
{初霜|はつしも} refers to the first frost of the season, marking the onset of cold weather. Compound of ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧ (first) + ⟦{霜|しも}→霜：03202_shimo⟧ (frost).

SEASONAL SIGNIFICANCE:
A ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (seasonal word) associated with late autumn in haiku poetry. Weather services report the date of {初霜|はつしも} each year as a seasonal milestone, and the timing varies by region.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The verb used with frost is ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (to descend/fall): {初霜|はつしも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (the first frost falls).

RELATED SEASONAL FIRSTS:
- ⟦{初雪|はつゆき}→初雪：11784_hatsuyuki⟧: first snow of the season
- {初氷|はつごおり}: first ice of the season
- ⟦{初日|はつひ}の{出|で}→初日の出：10452_hatsuhinode⟧: first sunrise of the new year

PRACTICAL NOTE:
Gardeners pay close attention to {初霜|はつしも} because frost-sensitive plants must be protected or brought indoors before it arrives.
